The consistent targeting of Low affinity cationic amino acid transporter 2 across different compounds suggests a possible mechanism involving the modulation of transporter activity, possibly through the regulation of cationic amino acid transport in cellular processes. The evidence supports a functional link between (+)-Corlumine and the transporter, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be elucidated.
